newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia tin rises on active demand, seen firm.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia tin rises on active demand, seen firm.

text.p: Malaysia's spot tin price rose 12 cents to 13.88 ringgit ($5.25) a kg after a higher close in London and further falls in ringgit against the U.S. dollar attracted more demand, traders said.

"The market was firm. There was a lot of active buying demand from all sectors, especially from Japan and Europe," a trader said. "If the ringgit continues to fall and London market rallies further, more demand will come in and the price should rise to 14 ringgit easily," a trader said.
There was an opening bid of 258 tonnes against offer of 42. Final turnover was 116 tonnes, against Wednesday's 113 tonnes.
The local premium over London was unchanged at Wednesday's $5 a tonne despite the ringgit's fall, traders said.
But with the underlying firm fundamentals, the market will rise further in the near-term, they said.
